purpose: Find a shield observation overlapping Fiora Riposte before reviewing shield/parry ordering
selection: Existing Ahri/Lich Bane/Fiora archive, followed by the first uninspected 16.20 replay with a shield-item-owning Fiora in a bounded five-entry replay-list search. This is targeted selection, not a random sample.

method.parry: Match Fiora buff hash 0x06d06887 add/remove records by slot token in wire order; use only matched observed windows.
method.shield: Read Fiora health and shield-* candidate state fields in wire order. Check positive updates within each window and last-observed positive fields before its start. Missing fields are not zero.
method.limits: Shield candidate fields are not independently calibrated. No positive overlap is not proof that shields were absent, nor evidence of server shield/parry ordering. No damage case is admitted.

decision: Retain the explicit shield-intact simulation assumption. Seek an observed overlapping shield/parry case with interpretable damage context before changing ordering.
